description: This file is a Bash script that automates building, running, and testing Docker-based plugin deployment and interaction workflows for a software project involving OpenClaw plugins. It includes functions to build images, start gateways, install plugins from various sources, verify plugin statuses, and run comprehensive integration tests.

methods.name: start_gateway
methods.description: Starts the Docker gateway process, waits until it is listening, and detects readiness.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Stops the gateway process if running.

methods.name: wait_for_gateway_health
methods.description: Polls the gateway health endpoint until it reports healthy.

methods.name: run_gateway_chat_json
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the gateway and waits for the assistant reply, writing output to a file.
